summary: No new defects found by static review. Both previous blocker fixes and both rebuttals are supported by inspection. Execution-dependent criteria remain unverified because checks were prohibited in the read-only sandbox.

checks.criterion: Tests precede implementation and a failing run is recorded.
checks.evidence: At commit 63bc9ea, test_geometry_resample.py imports lookup and resampler symbols absent from that commit's geometry.py. Notes exist at scripts/ralph/batches/t3-terrain/prd.json:167, but historical execution was not independently observed and cannot be rerun under the review restrictions.

checks.criterion: Three lookup forms have independent forward/inverse tests and explicit required georeferencing parameters.
checks.evidence: geometry.py:510,612,760 defines the three forms. Re-derived polar radius 2Rk0 tan(chi/2), north/south northing signs, equirectangular scales and half-pixel affine shifts agree with the implementation. Independent references appear at test_geometry_resample.py:158,218,240,256,265; directional assertions at :582,597,720,742,844,864; missing-parameter assertions at :409.

checks.criterion: Interpolation uses exactly four bilinear neighbours; missing neighbours and outside points produce nodata.
checks.evidence: geometry.py:1163 computes source bounds, :1166 selects the four-neighbour footprint, :1170 requires all four neighbours valid, and :1172 evaluates bilinear weights. At :1176 invalid outputs become NaN. Tests at test_geometry_resample.py:1156,1175,1186 exercise footprint isolation, outside points and missing zero-weight neighbours.

checks.criterion: A source plane in the window frame meets the specified residual tolerance at small equirectangular extent.
checks.evidence: test_geometry_resample.py:1950 constructs source elevations from independently calculated window-frame offsets. The test at :1958 checks the curvature allowance below atol/2, fits the output plane and applies rtol=1e-10, atol=1e-12. The curvature expansion and interpolation bound are consistent on paper; the numerical residual requires execution, prohibited by the read-only review instructions.

checks.criterion: Nodata tests establish exact footprint masking, all-nodata output and NaN/sentinel equivalence.
checks.evidence: Assertions cover exact footprints at test_geometry_resample.py:1199 and :1787, all-nodata inputs at :1239, and sentinel equivalence at :1226,1390,1447. These are substantive tests, but their outcomes were not observed because test execution was prohibited.

checks.criterion: Output includes float64 values and an explicit boolean valid mask; missing values are never zero.
checks.evidence: geometry.py:1074 enforces float64 values, :1076 enforces boolean masks, :1082 requires finite valid values, and :1084 requires NaN for invalid values. bilinear_resample constructs these outputs at :1175. Assertions at test_geometry_resample.py:1544 check dtype, shape, mask and missing-value representation.
Not executed: the user explicitly prohibited checks because dependency and test-cache writes cannot run in the read-only sandbox.
Not executed under the explicit read-only review restriction. Makefile:22 invokes uv-based ruff and mypy checks.

checks.criterion: Previous finding codex2-r1-1: masked source pixels become missing observations.
checks.evidence: Static fix verified: geometry.py:1137 extracts the mask before extracting data, and :1153 excludes masked pixels from validity. resample_window preserves the source at :1204. Regression assertions include the reported fully masked zero source at test_geometry_resample.py:1276 and window integration at :1842.

checks.criterion: Previous finding codex2-r1-2: sentinel detection uses the source storage type before float64 promotion.
checks.evidence: Static fix verified: geometry.py:1147 detects sentinels before :1148 promotes values. Float comparison casts the sentinel to the source dtype at :1238; integer comparison retains exact integers at :1248. Tests at test_geometry_resample.py:1371 and :1493 include rounded float32 sentinels and adjacent int64/uint64 values beyond 2**53.

checks.criterion: Previous rebuttal claude-r1-1: orchestration bookkeeping is permitted and product changes stay within scope.
checks.evidence: First-parent path inspection shows the listed implementation/test commits touch only geometry.py and test_geometry_resample.py. scripts/ralph/prompt.md:21 expressly permits the story list and progress log. Additional review/log files belong to orchestration commits.

checks.criterion: Previous rebuttal claude-r1-2: composition checks do not weaken the independent per-step tolerances.
checks.evidence: test_geometry_resample.py:99 retains rtol=1e-10 and atol=1e-12 for independent directional references. Projection and affine steps have separate reference assertions; composition wiring is checked at :975 and :992. Bitwise composition checks are not independent numerical oracles themselves, but supplement the independent component tests.
